message.content: {"caption":"Twelve-panel line chart comparing accuracy across math, code, and overall benchmark evaluations at x positions from 50 to 350.","description":"A 4-by-3 grid of small line charts. Each panel has an x-axis marked from 50 to 350 in steps of 50 and an Accuracy y-axis with a panel-specific scale; no x-axis label or legend is shown. The first two rows, grouped under the blue heading “MATH REASONING,” show blue series for AIME 2024, AIME 2025, Olympiad Bench, Minerva, Math 500, and AMC 2023. AIME 2024 fluctuates sharply at low accuracy, with a late spike near 0.20 before ending lower. AIME 2025 is mostly between 0 and 0.10, with several zero dips and a higher finish. Olympiad Bench varies within a narrow band around 0.35–0.38 and ends near 0.37. Minerva rises sharply from a low starting point and then fluctuates around 0.35–0.38. Math 500 generally trends upward from about 0.67, peaks near 0.77 late in the series, and drops at the endpoint. AMC 2023 is volatile, ranging roughly from 0.38 to 0.60, with a deep late dip and a rebound. The third row, under the orange heading “CODE REASONING,” shows orange series for HumanEval+, MBPP+, and LiveCodeBench. HumanEval+ generally rises from about 0.82 to the mid-0.84s with fluctuations; MBPP+ oscillates around 0.69–0.71, peaks late, then declines; LiveCodeBench trends upward from about 0.27 to about 0.32 with fluctuations. The bottom row, under the green heading “OVERALL PERFORMANCE,” shows Math Average in blue, Code Average in orange, and Overall Average in green. Math Average fluctuates but rises overall, ending near 0.38; Code Average has a gradual upward trend from about 0.59 to about 0.62; Overall Average rises from the mid-0.45s to around 0.50, with modest fluctuations. A red star marks the final, highest point of the Overall Average series, at approximately x=350 and accuracy 0.50.
